channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: A midnight burglar terrorizes a woman in Mesa County, Colorado, sparking a manhunt; a husband arrested for drug possession is desperate to bail out and find his wife; in Virginia Beach, a bicyclist is furious when he's arrested after being hit by a car, and a former convict fights to prove he's reformed and avoid a five-year prison sentence. In Hancock County, Mississippi, a frightened first-timer faces her first strip search after a DUI arrest.
